exceptions.rationale: paste is pulled by if-watch's rtnetlink implementation only on Linux; filtered Cargo metadata proves the proc macro is absent from every supported macOS and Windows release graph.
exceptions.removalTrigger: Remove when if-watch no longer records paste through its Linux netlink backend, or reject before adding Linux support.

exceptions.rationale: proc-macro-error is pulled by the GTK3 macro stack only on Linux; filtered Cargo metadata proves the build-time crate is absent from every supported macOS and Windows release graph.
exceptions.removalTrigger: Remove when Tauri no longer records the GTK3 macro stack, or reject the exception before adding any Linux release target.

exceptions.rationale: The unsound glib API is present only through Tauri's GTK3 Linux backend in the shared lockfile; filtered Cargo metadata proves glib is absent from every supported macOS and Windows release graph.
exceptions.removalTrigger: Remove as soon as Tauri leaves glib 0.18, and reject this exception before adding any Linux release target.
